_about: Product ranking profile. Read by app/services/product_ranking.py.
Orders the products that app/services/catalogue.py already permitted
for a step. Nothing here can make a product eligible: the six safety
conditions and the rules matrix decide that (CON-003). This file only
decides which permitted product is suggested first.
concernTerms     supportive (non-active) ingredients that suit each
concern the scan found. They become the query the
product's ingredient list is matched against.
skinTypeTerms    the same, for the user's skin type.
synonyms         names folded together before matching, so 'sodium
hyaluronate' and 'hyaluronic acid' count as one.
irritants        weighed against for users who report sensitive skin.
weights          how much each signal moves the score. Ties fall back
to product id, so equal products keep a stable order.
